title: One climate habit
summary: Pick one weekly habit that wastes less energy or materials.
objectives: Connect a daily habit to climate impact without panic
Commit to one realistic weekly habit
briefMarkdown:
## Mission

Climate care is often many small habits:
- Switch off unused fans/lights
- Carry a bottle instead of buying new plastic
- Walk short trips when safe
- Fix/reuse before replace

Pick **one** habit for 7 days. Track it.

quiz.prompt: Best climate habit approach for a student:

options.label: Do nothing because only big companies matter
Choose one realistic habit and repeat it
Claim you solved climate change alone

quiz.teachBack: Agency grows from repeatable habits, not guilt performances.

reflectionPrompt: Which one habit will you keep for 7 days, and how will you tick it each day?

supported.coachNote: Offer a menu of 5 easy habits.

steady.coachNote: Ask what might block the habit.

fast.coachNote: Ask how to invite family without lecturing.

llm.tutorBrief: No climate despair dumping. No shaming. Keep habits safe and affordable.
